turns.query: Who finished as the 2022-2023 Premier League's leading scorer, and with how many goals?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_top_scorer_name, tss_top_scorer_goals FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 1;
